claims.text: The chat_log shows the rider sent two locating messages inside the waiting window: at 18:21:00, 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?', and at 18:23:25, 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' The first names the rider's own position and the specific entrance; the second states that she cannot see the vehicle. Both fall between the driver's arrived event at 18:20:20 and the cancellation at 18:25:30, so they are messages 'during the waiting window' whose content is locating or coordinating. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 is met.

The driver never answered. The chat_log holds exactly three messages - the SYSTEM notice 'Your driver has arrived' at 18:20:21 and the two rider messages - and not one driver message at any point before termination; trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed either. Worse, the read receipts show the driver opened the rider's 18:21:00 message at 18:21:15 and her 18:23:25 message at 18:23:40, then stayed silent until he cancelled at 18:25:30 - over four minutes after reading. The driver neither replied within 120 seconds of either message nor called, so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is met.

The rider was where she said she was. The GPS trace's rider track is available and places the rider's device at a mean distance of 41.9 m from the pickup pin (max 41.9 m, min 41.9 m) on every one of the 16 qualifying fixes, which run from 18:20:30 to 18:25:30. That is 100 percent of qualifying fixes inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB, far more than the majority limb (c) of POL-NS-04 requires. No rider fix is filtered out for accuracy: rider_fix_count and rider_qualifying_fix_count are both 16. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is met.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, and that clause is mandatory in its terms: the rider 'is exonerated and the cancellation fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable'. The rider was present at the registered pickup bay, she identified her entrance in the chat log, she asked twice where the car was, and the driver read both messages and answered neither by message or by call before terminating. The contested SGD 6.00 must be returned to the rider and no fee-funded or platform-funded payment is owed to the driver on this trip.

The rider does not dispute that the driver's own trace puts him 24.0 m from the pin, stationary, for a continuous 330 second qualifying run from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30 - 30 seconds more than the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum - so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are met on their own terms and the rider's case does not rest on denying them. But POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable 'ONLY IF' the four conditions hold 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'. POL-NS-04 sits inside that range and its three limbs are satisfied here, so POL-NS-01 is displaced and does not carry the charge. A long, quiet wait by the driver does not cure his failure to answer a rider who was standing 42 m away and asking for him by name of entrance.

The money at stake is entirely on the rider's side of the ledger. The fare breakdown shows a single cancellation_fee of SGD 6.00 charged at 18:25:32, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, platform_fee, tolls and surcharges all 0.00. The contested amount of SGD 6.00 is therefore exactly the sum a full refund returns, and the 'present state' under POL-GEN-03 is a charge that stays in place only if the rider's claim fails - which, on POL-NS-04, it does not.

There is no reason to hold this dispute rather than decide it. None of the POL-NS-09 escalation limbs is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, below the 2 that limb (c) requires - these are the only profile fields the clause reads, and the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags (1 for the rider, 2 for the driver) are not substitutes for them. The rider's refund can issue now.

The rider's case does not depend on any impaired artifact, so no discount applies to it. The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 34 fixes, a 10 second sample interval, zero gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0; the rider track is present, as POL-NS-08(b) requires where a clause relies on rider position; the chat_log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 with an unbroken msg_id sequence 001-003 and no gap over 5 minutes spanning the arrival marker; the arrived event at 18:20:20 coincides exactly with a GPS fix, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a); and the SGD 6.00 fee line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, being the GREATER of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the SGD 6.00 RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0.

The traffic-advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09106-01 is MISSING: no advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window, and it carries weight 0.0, so it can carry no fact and I disclose that. Its absence is itself citable and assists the rider: nothing on this record - no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT at the Tampines private-hire bay in the 18:20 to 18:25 window - explains why the driver, having read the rider's messages, could not answer her or close the last few metres to her. There is no external obstruction in evidence to set against his silence.

claims.text: POL-NS-01 is satisfied on clean platform telemetry of weight 1.0, limb by limb. Limb (a): the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:20:20. Limb (b): the driver's own trace places him 24.01 m from the pickup pin — inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius — from 18:20:00, before that event. Limb (c): he held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 330 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, the dwell being measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 and not from the arrived marker. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:25:30 on code RIDER_NO_SHOW, thirty seconds after the required dwell elapsed, with no boarding event recorded. The cancellation fee was therefore legitimately chargeable when it was levied.

The arrival gate in POL-NS-02 is passed on the driver's own trace: 34 qualifying fixes fall inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, and every one of them is 24.01 m from the pickup pin. The driver was not merely somewhere near the pickup point; he was virtually on it, stationary, for the whole waiting window. No argument that the driver never arrived is open to the rider on this record.

POL-NS-05 has no purchase here. At the arrived timestamp the driver was stationary — the only speed anywhere across the 34 fixes is 0.0 km/h, far under the 15 km/h motion threshold — and 24.01 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m limit at which the arrival marker could be called false. The arrival marker is true, the waiting clock needs no recomputation, and there is no false-arrival event to record against the driver.

POL-NS-06, the shortfall clause, is not engaged at all. The effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous 330 seconds, thirty seconds above the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09106-01, MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) does not enter the analysis: limb (i) accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals is only ever needed when the dwell falls short, and this driver's single run does not, so the absence of any advisory on this pickup road changes nothing.

The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee reconciles exactly with the fee schedule's resolution rule: it is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00), a tie at SGD 6.00. The fare breakdown therefore shows no defect under POL-NS-08(d), carries no impairment, and itemises the charge as POL-NS-01 requires.

On POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee — SGD 4.80 — and the anti-farming bar does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 termination across 120 completed trips is a ratio of 0.008, far below 0.08. Compensation is therefore payable rather than withheld, and the outcome this case produces on that footing is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 4.80 under POL-GEN-03, with the rider's own charge left standing.

I state plainly the clause that decides this case against the driver, because the record supports the rider on it and I will not stretch the record. The chat log shows the rider sending locating messages inside the waiting window at 18:21:00 and 18:23:25; the driver posted no reply and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no reply and no call; and the rider's own track carries 16 qualifying fixes, all 41.9 m from the pin, well inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius. Limbs (a), (b) and (c) of POL-NS-04 are each made out. My case is confined to what the record does support: the driver's arrival and dwell met POL-NS-01 in full, so this was not a fabricated no-show — but POL-NS-04 is one of the clauses POL-NS-01 itself yields to, and it carries the fee to a full refund with no driver compensation.

ruling.explanation:
Driver and rider: this case turns on the chat record, and it goes in the rider's favour.

On the driver's side, the claims that the no-show charge was earned are accepted as facts. The driver's own GPS trace and trip record show he met POL-NS-01 limb by limb: he was 24.0 m from the pickup pin, stationary (0.0 km/h across all 34 fixes), inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius from 18:20:00, which is before the 18:20:20 'arrived' marker; he held that position for a single continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum (the dwell measured from the first qualifying fix, not the marker); and he terminated at 18:25:30 on code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 30 seconds after the minimum elapsed, with no boarding event. The POL-NS-02 arrival gate is passed; the POL-NS-05 false-arrival test is not engaged (he was stationary and 24 m from the pin, so the marker is true and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed); POL-NS-06 is not engaged because a 330-second run leaves no shortfall; and the SGD 6.00 fee reconciles with the fee schedule under POL-NS-08(d), being the greater of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the SGD 6.00 RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (a tie at SGD 6.00). Those claims do not decide the case, because POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable 'ONLY IF' no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

POL-NS-04 displaces it. The chat log shows the rider sent two locating messages inside the waiting window: at 18:21:00, 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' (her own position and a specific entrance, and a request for the driver's position), and at 18:23:25, 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' (a statement that she cannot see the vehicle). The driver posted no reply at any point and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so he neither replied within 120 seconds nor called before terminating; the read receipts show he opened both messages (18:21:15 and 18:23:40) and stayed silent until cancelling. The rider's own track places her device at 41.9 m from the pin on all 16 qualifying fixes (rider_fix_count and rider_qualifying_fix_count both 16), inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius for 100 percent of fixes, more than the majority limb (c) requires. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full. The driver's claim to 80 percent of the fee — SGD 4.80 under POL-NS-07 — is rejected: POL-NS-07 applies only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and POL-NS-04 both displaces it and states expressly that no driver compensation is payable. The anti-farming check not tripping (no_show_terminations_30d 1, ratio 0.008) therefore does not matter.

On the figures: the contested amount and the single charged line are the same SGD 6.00 (fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 6.00, total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, all other fare lines 0.00). A full refund returns SGD 6.00 and no driver compensation is payable.

Two further points. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09106-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0; the rider's claim resting on it was discarded by the referee and appears in the audit record, and in any event POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation is never reached because there is no shortfall, so the missing advisory changes nothing. No artifact carrying the deciding facts is impaired: the GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 34 fixes, a 10-second interval, zero gaps and a present rider track; the chat log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 on an unbroken msg_id sequence 001-003; and the arrived timestamp coincides with a GPS fix, so POL-NS-08(a) to (d) are not engaged and no confidence discount or escalation follows. No escalation limb is engaged either: confidence is not below the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d fields are 0 (limb (c) needs 2), no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (limb (d) needs 3), and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence (limb (e)). No clause produces a referral, so none is recorded.

No rider fix is filtered out for accuracy: rider_fix_count and rider_qualifying_fix_count are both 16. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is met.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, and that clause is mandatory in its terms: the rider 'is exonerated and the cancellation fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable'. The rider was present at the registered pickup bay, she identified her entrance in the chat log, she asked twice where the car was, and the driver read both messages and answered neither by message or by call before terminating. The contested SGD 6.00 must be returned to the rider and no fee-funded or platform-funded payment is owed to the driver on this trip.

The rider does not dispute that the driver's own trace puts him 24.0 m from the pin, stationary, for a continuous 330 second qualifying run from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30 - 30 seconds more than the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum - so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are met on their own terms and the rider's case does not rest on denying them. But POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable 'ONLY IF' the four conditions hold 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'. POL-NS-04 sits inside that range and its three limbs are satisfied here, so POL-NS-01 is displaced and does not carry the charge. A long, quiet wait by the driver does not cure his failure to answer a rider who was standing 42 m away and asking for him by name of entrance.

The money at stake is entirely on the rider's side of the ledger. The fare breakdown shows a single cancellation_fee of SGD 6.00 charged at 18:25:32, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, platform_fee, tolls and surcharges all 0.00. The contested amount of SGD 6.00 is therefore exactly the sum a full refund returns, and the 'present state' under POL-GEN-03 is a charge that stays in place only if the rider's claim fails - which, on POL-NS-04, it does not.

There is no reason to hold this dispute rather than decide it. None of the POL-NS-09 escalation limbs is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, below the 2 that limb (c) requires - these are the only profile fields the clause reads, and the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags (1 for the rider, 2 for the driver) are not substitutes for them. The rider's refund can issue now.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is satisfied on clean platform telemetry of weight 1.0, limb by limb. Limb (a): the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:20:20. Limb (b): the driver's own trace places him 24.01 m from the pickup pin — inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius — from 18:20:00, before that event. Limb (c): he held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 330 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, the dwell being measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 and not from the arrived marker. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:25:30 on code RIDER_NO_SHOW, thirty seconds after the required dwell elapsed, with no boarding event recorded. The cancellation fee was therefore legitimately chargeable when it was levied.

The arrival gate in POL-NS-02 is passed on the driver's own trace: 34 qualifying fixes fall inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, and every one of them is 24.01 m from the pickup pin. The driver was not merely somewhere near the pickup point; he was virtually on it, stationary, for the whole waiting window. No argument that the driver never arrived is open to the rider on this record.

POL-NS-05 has no purchase here. At the arrived timestamp the driver was stationary — the only speed anywhere across the 34 fixes is 0.0 km/h, far under the 15 km/h motion threshold — and 24.01 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m limit at which the arrival marker could be called false. The arrival marker is true, the waiting clock needs no recomputation, and there is no false-arrival event to record against the driver.

POL-NS-06, the shortfall clause, is not engaged at all. The effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous 330 seconds, thirty seconds above the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09106-01, MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) does not enter the analysis: limb (i) accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals is only ever needed when the dwell falls short, and this driver's single run does not, so the absence of any advisory on this pickup road changes nothing.

The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee reconciles exactly with the fee schedule's resolution rule: it is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00), a tie at SGD 6.00. The fare breakdown therefore shows no defect under POL-NS-08(d), carries no impairment, and itemises the charge as POL-NS-01 requires.

On POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee — SGD 4.80 — and the anti-farming bar does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 termination across 120 completed trips is a ratio of 0.008, far below 0.08. Compensation is therefore payable rather than withheld, and the outcome this case produces on that footing is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 4.80 under POL-GEN-03, with the rider's own charge left standing.

I state plainly the clause that decides this case against the driver, because the record supports the rider on it and I will not stretch the record. The chat log shows the rider sending locating messages inside the waiting window at 18:21:00 and 18:23:25; the driver posted no reply and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no reply and no call; and the rider's own track carries 16 qualifying fixes, all 41.9 m from the pin, well inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius. Limbs (a), (b) and (c) of POL-NS-04 are each made out. My case is confined to what the record does support: the driver's arrival and dwell met POL-NS-01 in full, so this was not a fabricated no-show — but POL-NS-04 is one of the clauses POL-NS-01 itself yields to, and it carries the fee to a full refund with no driver compensation.
